acceptance_criteria.description: summarize returns correct sums for empty, header-only, BOM, CRLF, quoted commas/escaped quotes, skipped empty records, preserved categories
summarize raises ValueError for bad header, malformed quoting, wrong field count, and non-^[0-9]+$ counts (whitespace, negative, non-ASCII)
CLI with one UTF-8 file prints sorted-keys JSON plus one newline; invalid/usage exits 2 with empty stdout
python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v is green; entry points and stdlib-only small implementation preserved

assumptions: Header is parsed as CSV and must equal ["category","count"] exactly.
Blank CSV records ([]) are empty records and skipped.
Only Python 3.12 standard library; keep csv_summary.summarize and cli.main entry points.
discoveries: csv_summary.py summarize uses splitlines+split(',')+int(): breaks quoted commas/escaped quotes, multiline CRLF fields, BOM header, strict count checks, field-count/quote errors.

cli.py main()->int for `python cli.py INPUT.csv` reads UTF-8, calls summarize, print(json.dumps(sort_keys=True)): usage/invalid->2+stderr shape correct but inherits API bugs; must buffer output to avoid partial stdout.
tests/test_public.py has 3 tests (repeat-sum, quoted-comma, CLI sorted JSON); missing BOM/CRLF/strict-count/invalid-input coverage.
Contract requires csv.reader semantics with strict=True, leading BOM strip, ^[0-9]+$ counts, quotes only as delimiters/escaped quotes.
goal: Fix CSV summary API and CLI per contract while preserving entry points and add focused public regression tests.
risks: Multiline quoted fields and lone \r mishandled if not using csv.reader.
int() accepts whitespace/underscore/unicode digits so regex gate is required.
CLI partial stdout if printing before full validation.

steps.instructions: Rewrite summarize(text:str)->dict in csv_summary.py using io.StringIO+csv.reader(strict=True): strip one leading \ufeff, return {} if text=="", require header==["category","count"] else ValueError, skip [] rows, require len==2 else ValueError, require re ^[0-9]+$ on counts then int() and sum by preserved category, normalize csv.Error to ValueError.
steps.title: Rewrite summarize with strict CSV validation

steps.instructions: Audit cli.py main()->int keeping signature and `python cli.py INPUT.csv`: read_text utf-8, call summarize, build json.dumps(sort_keys=True)+"\n" string then single write/print so invalid exits 2 with empty stdout; only edit if buffering or passthrough needs fix.
steps.title: Confirm CLI atomic sorted JSON output

steps.instructions: Add focused tests in tests/test_public.py: BOM/CRLF/escaped-quotes/empty/header-only/sum-repeats, rejects for bad header/field-count/malformed quotes/whitespace/negative/non-ASCII counts, CLI success newline+sorted keys and CLI failure exit 2 empty stdout.
steps.title: Add focused public regression tests

verification_strategy.description: API matrix: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v covering valid and ValueError cases
CLI checks: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v including subprocess CLI success/failure (exit 2 empty stdout) tests
Full suite: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v and confirm green
